name: bld3_nilpotent_rank_pow_le
statement: (K : Type*) [Field K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K) (hA : IsNilpotent A) (k : ℕ) : Matrix.rank (A ^ k) ≤ Fintype.card ι - k
closed: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K) (hA : IsNilpotent A) (k : ℕ), Matrix.rank (A ^ k) ≤ Fintype.card ι - k
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld2_rank_pow_convex and Mathlib2.bld_nilpotent_rank_bound: by convexity the drops d_k are non-increasing, so once d_k = 0 the rank is constant forever; nilpotency forces that constant to be 0, hence the rank drops by at least 1 at each step until it reaches 0, giving rank A^k ≤ n - k (truncated subtraction).
type: ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] (ι : Type u_2) [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K), IsNilpotent A → ∀ (k : ℕ), (A ^ k).rank ≤ Fintype.card ι - k
